description: The final campaign against the Ori sends SG-1 to the Ori galaxy in search of the Ark of Truth, then a last confrontation with Ba’al fractures history itself. The two missions close the Ori war and the surviving Goa’uld System Lords while forcing SG-1 to fight for the timeline that created the Stargate program.

s11e01-02.description: With the Ori armies still active, SG-1 searches the Ori galaxy for the Ark of Truth, an Ancient device that could expose Origin’s deception and end the war.

s11e03-04.description: Ba’al travels into Earth’s past and prevents the Stargate program from ever forming, leaving Carter, Daniel and Mitchell to restore a history only they remember.
